scope: ONE fixed pretrained RoBERTa three-way reader with actual native RuVector evidence and same-model lexical/positional controls; internal original ContractNLI NDA pilot only.
data: Exact reserved CONF48/16 groups SHA256 850b1f1d61d81ee83227ff3e62696011a9571b9349cbf926d61243bfacadbf50. Project-model-unused; public-source pretraining overlap unknown. Never use previously exposed f018 CONF96, easy48 or Legal96 as fresh confirmation.

required.accuracy_point_nondecrease: Primary correct >= each of all three controls.
required.proper_loss_point_nonincrease: Primary Brier and NLL <= each of all three controls + 1e-12.
required.accuracy_supported_gain: Paired document-cluster percentile bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 against EACH of all three controls, including same-excerpt Native104.
required.proper_noninferiority_supported: Bootstrap 95% lower bound >= -1e-12 for control-minus-primary Brier and NLL against EACH of all three controls.
required.strict_proper_gain_matched: At least one point proper loss gain >1e-12 against EACH same-model lexical and positional control.
required.native_and_controls: Same exact new pretrained reader, BPE tokenizer, full three-class softmax T1 and epoch6 packing algorithm with new BPE token budgets for all three selectors. Native104 receives exact primary packed excerpt plus original question; diagnostic, not full submitted champion.
required.execution: Only after strict DEV24 plus frozen runtime/lease admission: one separate nonretryable CPU2 <=600s CONF48 process including all source verification/model initialization and cleanup. TRAIN/calibration empty; no fits, precision/threshold choice, rescue or retry.

bootstrap.unit: 16 document groups; mean three correlated query gains per group; paired resampling of 16 groups with replacement.
bootstrap.gain_sign: Accuracy = primary minus control; proper = control loss minus primary loss.
bootstrap.multiplicity: Nominal unadjusted exploratory intervals; no familywise, full-benchmark or official SOTA claim.

failure: Any gate failure rejects. ANY confirmation phase Popen invocation attempt conservatively retires all48 even without PID/HTTP; separately report actual requests/model consumption. No precision/context/threshold rescue or retry.
official_scope: No submitted champion promotion or official JevBench/LegalBench/ClaimBench score/rank without independently accepted DEV+unusedCONF and matching publisher result/eligibility.
